rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the human body-part sense of “hip.”

example.english: The doctor said my hip is slightly inflamed.
example.traditional: 醫生話我嘅髖部有少少發炎。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ge3 fun1 bou6 jau5 siu2 siu2 faat3 jim4

rows.note: Use this only for the sloping external intersection on a roof, not for a body part.

example.english: The hip on this house needs rebuilding.
example.traditional: 呢座屋嘅斜脊要重新整過。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 uk1 ge3 ce4 zek3 jiu3 cung4 san1 zing2 gwo3
